units.title: SG-5.5 · Scheduler behavior with a fake clock unit tests
Act: Confirm Tick open and close dispatch against the injected clock
Act: Confirm Tick collects errors and continues after a Controller failure
Verify: Scheduler open, close and boundary behavior with a fake clock unit tests

tests.name: TestTick_OpensDueRound
tests.title: Opens a SCHEDULED round once its start time has passed
tests.scenario: Given a SCHEDULED round starting 11:00 and ending 13:00 and a clock at 12:00, when Tick runs, then it returns nil and calls Open for w1/r1 only
tests.detail: Step 1. Existing test kept unchanged. Line numbers in the brief are offset (actual L69-84).

tests.name: TestTick_ClosesExpiredRound
tests.title: Closes an OPEN round once its end time has passed
tests.scenario: Given an OPEN round ending 11:59 and a clock at 12:00, when Tick runs, then it returns nil and calls Close for w1/r1 only
tests.detail: Step 2. Existing test kept unchanged. Line numbers in the brief are offset (actual L87-102).

tests.name: TestTick_IgnoresFutureAndOtherStatuses
tests.title: Ignores future and COMPLETED rounds until the boundary is reached
tests.scenario: Given a future SCHEDULED round starting 13:00, a future OPEN round ending 13:00 and a COMPLETED round, when Tick runs at 12:00 then no calls are made; when the clock moves to 13:00 and Tick runs, then Open runs for future-scheduled and Close runs for future-open
tests.detail: Step 3. Existing test kept unchanged. Line numbers in the brief are offset (actual L106-136). Covers the inclusive 13:00 boundary for both open and close.

units.title: Verify: Tick open failure is returned and Close still runs unit tests

tests.name: TestTick_OpenErrorIsReturnedAndCloseStillRuns
tests.title: Tick returns the Open error and still runs Close for the expired round
tests.scenario: Given a controller whose Open fails, a due SCHEDULED round and an expired OPEN round in one world; When Tick runs; Then the error wraps the Open error and the calls are open(due-scheduled) then close(expired-open)

units.title: REQ · Tick opens due SCHEDULED rounds, closes expired OPEN rounds and waits for future and COMPLETED rounds
REQ · Tick returns an Open failure and still closes another due round
